provenance.reworkedBy: Txema Vicente (manual cleanup), then Codex (AI coding agent) under his direction using data from the Honda manual
provenance.source: Cleaned up by hand by Txema Vicente over several hours, then substantially reworked by Codex under his direction using data from the Honda manual, starting from a low-quality base mesh; almost none of the original geometry remains. Base mesh: the user-supplied interceptor.glb. Prepared and visually approved on 2026-10-08.
edits: 2026-10-08 scripts/prepare-vfr800-cockpit.mjs: the existing fairing mirrors split into mirror_L / mirror_R nodes under Body; static needles, hubs and speedometer tick marks removed for the live instruments; gauge and lamp anchors added; windscreen switched from transmission to alpha blending with a neutral smoke-grey tint and a slight reflection (extras.nabla.envIntensity 0.35); chrome only on the brake discs (authored tracks and floating buttons) and a new stainless end cap on the silencer (base 0.95 grey, metallic 1, roughness 0.12, extras.nabla.envIntensity 0.75); the exhaust headers, the silencer can and the engine cases behind the radiator moved to the satin aluminium of the top triple clamp; the fork stanchions a new polished aluminium grey (base 0.5, metallic 1, roughness 0.3); chain, sprockets, radiator, swingarm, headlamp reflector and mirror glass keep their authored materials.

2026-10-08 metal map review (Txema): first pass had a mirror chrome (roughness 0.03, envIntensity 1.25, then 0.12 / 0.75) on the fork stanchions, the silencer can and its end cap; now only the end cap keeps it, the can is satin aluminium and the stanchions polished aluminium. Regenerated from the phase-1 GLB (1de7fde) with scripts/prepare-vfr800-cockpit.mjs.

2026-10-08 chrome like the rims (Txema: the trim glowed in shade and at night, and he wants it whiter): the silencer end cap and the disc buttons are base 0.93, metallic 1, roughness 0.15 with no extra env intensity. The reflection environment is now attenuated by the surface's own light, so chrome darkens in shadow and at night and never reads as self-lit.
